channel.title: thinkingmachines/inkling-2-mini — The Marginal Token
channel.description: Changes that affect the cost of buying and running AI.

item.title: AI model releases, 16–22 November 2026
item.description: Gemini 4 Carbon’s scheduled increase doubles a long-prompt coding bill. This week also brought metered Qwen4-Max access, GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra, new image and speech options, and downloadable weights.

item.title: Inkling 2 Mini runs on a laptop. What does the hosted route cost?
item.description: Thinking Machines demonstrated offline coding on a 48 GB MacBook Pro. A hosted workload with one million input tokens and 100,000 output tokens costs about 11 cents at the observed OpenRouter price.
